claims.claim: Habits are learned tendencies for behaviour to occur in recurring contexts; not every repeated action is automatic. Context cues can become associated with a response over time. Lally and colleagues studied repeated everyday behaviours and found variability in automaticity trajectories; no fixed number of days guarantees a habit. A cue should be observable, frequent enough and connected to an action that is feasible. Motivation may help initiate a routine but is not a substitute for a workable environment.
